description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1073: eval code that a CommonJS or ES module file runs has V8's position in its eval origin, as Node 22.22.0 compiles modules as scripts (eval at f (/abs/a.js:2:3), an ES module's as its file: URL), so an uncaught error in it prints the <anonymous_script>:N header with the eval'd source line and caret; a CommonJS and an ES module file, an ES module line whose imports the transform renames, a nested eval, a hashbang file, a promise callback, a required module, a function the eval code defines, two caught stacks, a file with a top-level return, and a file whose code would close the module wrapper early, which throws its SyntaxError without running any of it (frames other than eval frames left out: Node's are its own)
